## Cadence is on a mission to deliver life-changing treatment to 1 million people with chronic conditions by the end of the decade.

![](https://assets.cadence.care/images/testimonials/cover-photo-01.webp)![](https://assets.cadence.care/images/testimonials/cover-photo-02.webp)![](https://assets.cadence.care/images/testimonials/cover-photo-03.webp)![](https://assets.cadence.care/images/testimonials/cover-photo-04.webp)![](https://assets.cadence.care/images/testimonials/cover-photo-05.webp)

I have control over my health. This is the first time I've ever seen the difference that how I take care of myself directly translates into my wellbeing, my blood pressure, just everything about my life. 1

**Lynda** Hypertension patient, Chicago

I always had high blood pressure and I chose not to medicate myself for it, which was a mistake. \[With Cadence\] I've learned to eat with portion control. I've lost 40 pounds recently. That's helped in reducing my blood pressure. Now, my BP is 107 over 68. 1

**Alan** Hypertension patient, Chicago

We measure how many inbox messages \[our clinicians\] get, and it's less than 1% of a change in their inbox when they put their panel in Cadence. 1

**Dr. Jessica Schlicher** Former Chief Medical Officer, Providence

My life is so much better than it ever was before because I'm able to do the things that I wasn't able to do 10 years ago. I'm healthier now. 1

**Kathy** Hypertension patient, Alabama

If we're able to have a product that takes a lot of the manual labor out, is efficient, is backed by evidence-based medicine, then that becomes a win for everybody. 1

**Dr. Sunita Koshy-Nesbitt** Chief Medical and Quality Officer, Texas Health Resources

Remote Patient Care isn't about replacing in-person care. Instead, it complements traditional care by helping physicians focus on the most relevant clinical data over time, ensuring better patient outcomes. 1

**Dr. Marat Fudim MD, MHS** Advanced Heart Failure Specialist, Cardiologist, Duke Health

## The Cadence difference

![Clinical Intelligence](https://assets.cadence.care/images/difference/clinical-intelligence-mark-v2.png)

### Clinical Intelligence

AI and clinical workflows that automate the predictable, escalate the complex, and improve with every patient interaction.

![Multidisciplinary Clinical Care Team](https://assets.cadence.care/images/difference/multidisciplinary.png)

### Multidisciplinary Clinical Care Team

Our physician-led clinical team extends your practice, supporting patients between visits without adding workload.

![EMR-Native Technology](https://assets.cadence.care/images/difference/provider-intelligence.png)

### EMR-Native Technology

Seamlessly integrated into your workflow, no new systems required.

Peer reviewed & data driven

$1,302

Decrease in total cost of care per patient per year

![Mayo Clinic Proceedings](https://assets.cadence.care/images/research/mayo-clinic.png)[View Paper](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2542454825000906)

### The Impact of a Remote Patient Care Program on Healthcare Costs and Utilization Among Medicare Patients With Chronic Disease

Published in Mayo Clinic Proceedings, February 2026 2

$1,428 Decrease in inpatient spend per patient per year

27% Reduction in hospital admissions

8.4 Day reduction in length of hospital stay for stroke patients

$203

Monthly cost savings per patient

![NEJM Catalyst](https://assets.cadence.care/images/research/nejm-catalyst.png)[View Paper](https://catalyst.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/CAT.24.0521)

### Scaling Remote Patient Care: The Mechanics of a Paradigm Shift in Chronic Disease Management

Published in NEJM Catalyst, October 2025 3

4.9/5 Patient satisfaction with an NPS of +40

43% Increase in blood pressure control

107% Increase in HFrEF patients on all four pillars of GDMT

![](https://assets.cadence.care/images/research/jcf-chart.png)

![Journal of Cardiac Failure](https://assets.cadence.care/images/research/jcf-logo.png)[View Paper](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1071916424001740)

### Leveraging Remote Patient Monitoring to Effectively Put the Heart Failure Guidelines to Practice

Published in the Journal of Cardiac Failure, Sept 2024 4

$1,077 Monthly cost savings per heart failure patient

19% Increase in SGLT2 inhibitor use (26% → 45%)

5.3 Systolic BP improved from 131 → 124

![](https://assets.cadence.care/images/research/jacc-graph.png)

![JACC: Advances](https://assets.cadence.care/images/research/jacc-logo.png)[View Paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jacadv.2025.101892)

Published in JACC: Advances, July 2025 5

23,638 Patients, 57% in rural or underserved areas

75% Patients measuring vitals at 6 months

7/5 mmHg Average blood pressure reduction

Decrease in hospital admissions
